source_registry.title: GLI standards catalogue
source_registry.supports: Distinguishes devices, bingo/keno, interactive systems, event wagering, cashless, kiosks, client/server and other system scopes.
source_registry.claim_limit: GLI is a test standards provider; jurisdictions decide adoption; catalogue does not set occupations.

source_registry.title: GLI iGaming technical services
source_registry.supports: Names games/RTP, RNG, sports/esports, platforms/RGS, live dealer, geolocation, exchanges and security testing.
source_registry.claim_limit: Service catalogue, not neutral academic taxonomy or proof each item is a separate specialization.

source_registry.title: UK Gambling Commission Remote Gambling and Software Technical Standards
source_registry.supports: Separate requirements address rules/likelihood of winning, result determination, random outcomes, jackpots, interruption, collusion, financial limits, reality checks, responsible design, in-play betting, third-party software and live studios.
source_registry.claim_limit: Great Britain remote-licence scope; applicability differs by product and jurisdiction.

source_registry.title: UKGC testing strategy
source_registry.supports: Defines product testing timing/procedure, annual games testing, live RTP monitoring, release practice and third-party security audits.
source_registry.claim_limit: UK licence context; not a universal testing mandate.

source_registry.title: UKGC game/RNG test reports
source_registry.supports: Requires licensed remote products in scope to submit game and RNG test results for assurance on new games/major updates.
source_registry.claim_limit: License/product-specific and jurisdiction-specific.

source_registry.title: UKGC responsible product design RTS 14
source_registry.supports: Responsible product design includes avoiding active encouragement to chase losses or continue after a user wants to stop.
source_registry.claim_limit: Specific regulator standard; implementation must follow current official edition and applicable license.

source_registry.title: WLA Security Control Standard 2024
source_registry.supports: Covers lottery operation, game-system/service development, integrity, event/odds/result management, RNG and online game controls.
source_registry.claim_limit: Industry standard/certification, not law everywhere or full academic taxonomy.

source_registry.title: WLA-SCS:2024 standard PDF
source_registry.supports: Explicit control annexes distinguish organizational controls, game operations, system/service development and multijurisdictional games.
source_registry.claim_limit: Lottery operator/supplier lens; not all betting/casino work is covered.

source_registry.title: FCT Lottery Regulation Office gaming categories
source_registry.supports: FCT categories include retail/online lottery, promotional games, sports betting, raffles, pari-mutuel/fixed-odds, casino, interactive/mobile and emerging games.
source_registry.claim_limit: FCT regulator page; not evidence of uniform Nigerian jurisdictional rules. Verify legal status/effective text before any legal assertion.

source_registry.title: FCT-LRO permit requirements archive
source_registry.supports: Separate documents exist for mobile/interactive gaming, sports betting, casino, lottery and emerging services.
source_registry.claim_limit: Administrative permit material; verify dates/current legal status before student compliance guidance.

source_registry.title: Lagos State Lotteries and Gaming Authority
source_registry.supports: State regulator describes lottery, betting, casino, gaming-machine and online/retail categories plus compliance/enforcement.
source_registry.claim_limit: Lagos jurisdiction only; the regulator’s statements about national jurisdiction are not independently adopted here.

source_registry.title: MGA prior approval requirements
source_registry.supports: New game submissions can require RNG certificate, technical setup, gaming system specification and game-engine information.
source_registry.claim_limit: Malta licence requirements only.

source_registry.title: MGA technical infrastructure guidance
source_registry.supports: Defines critical components such as RNG, jackpot and player database servers; discusses ISMS/security hosting.
source_registry.claim_limit: Malta-specific regulator guidance; verify current edition.

source_registry.title: AGA Responsible Gaming Statutes and Regulations Guide (2025)
source_registry.supports: Compiles responsible-gaming legal frameworks in U.S. states with specified commercial products.
source_registry.claim_limit: Industry association compilation, U.S. subset and dated snapshot; not a global legal source.

source_registry.title: ProvablyFair.org methodology
source_registry.supports: Describes commit-reveal, independent RNG/game logic, RTP and reproducible audit approaches for crypto casino products.
source_registry.claim_limit: Private vendor/assurance methodology; no industry-wide standard and limited product scope. Treat as a grey-area example, not regulator approval.

source_registry.title: FCT-LRO sports betting permit
source_registry.supports: FCT material describes systems inspections, monitoring/reporting connection, third-party technical providers and periodic system audit.
source_registry.claim_limit: Local administrative requirements; not general Nigerian employment or legal advice.

source_registry.title: UKGC responsible product design RTS 14 details
source_registry.supports: Standards scope explicitly distinguishes features by product (casino, slots, etc.).
source_registry.claim_limit: Requirements are product- and jurisdiction-dependent.

source_registry.title: UKGC interactive remote sector guidance
source_registry.supports: Defines remote gambling modalities and licensing guidance for apps, web, TV and other communication channels.
source_registry.claim_limit: Great Britain licensing scope; not a universal definition.

source_registry.title: WLA-SCS 2024 Code of Practice
source_registry.supports: Detailed draw procedures, audit evidence, odds/event/result management, settlement and RNG verification; cites chi-square among possible RNG checks.
source_registry.claim_limit: Lottery/operator standard; testing methods are examples, not a complete statistical curriculum.

source_registry.title: Virginia casino facility internal controls
source_registry.supports: Regulatory source specifies separate surveillance and audit functions, cashiers' cage controls and accountability.
source_registry.claim_limit: Virginia jurisdiction; other jurisdictions differ.

source_registry.title: NSW Independent Casino Commission harm and crime controls
source_registry.supports: Describes staff training and systems to recognize harm, KYC/financial transaction controls and exclusion risks.
source_registry.claim_limit: NSW-specific regulator summary; not globally prescriptive.

source_registry.title: UKGC bingo/casino RNG technical requirements
source_registry.supports: RNG results must be acceptably random and demonstrable using statistical analysis and accepted testing methods.
source_registry.claim_limit: Great Britain requirements; statistical tests do not by themselves establish fairness of complete game design.

source_registry.title: Victorian gaming machine standards
source_registry.supports: 2025/26 updates restrict losses disguised as wins, programmable near-misses and jackpot-qualifying bet mechanics; monitoring systems also have requirements.
source_registry.claim_limit: Victoria-only legal context and effective dates; not universal game design rules.

source_registry.title: FCT-LRO about and regulatory remit
source_registry.supports: FCT body describes licensing, monitoring and player protection across lottery, sports betting, casino, interactive/mobile and emerging services.
source_registry.claim_limit: FCT scope; regulator statements do not settle national/state legal allocation.

source_registry.title: FCT-LRO general guidelines
source_registry.supports: Facility inspection can include server centre, providers, head office and model outlets.
source_registry.claim_limit: Local application guidance; verify operative legal instrument and version before student legal advice.

source_registry.title: Lagos State regulator overview
source_registry.supports: Lists online lottery, online sports betting, casino, scratch cards, gaming machines, pools betting and other games.
source_registry.claim_limit: Lagos only; site-level summary rather than complete law.

source_registry.title: AGA responsible gaming legal guide 2025
source_registry.supports: Cross-state compilation of U.S. responsible gaming statutes and regulations.
source_registry.claim_limit: Industry association, 2025 snapshot, U.S.-only jurisdictions listed.
